Basic chat completion against real Anthropic API

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.literllm.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var reqJson = "{\"max_tokens\":10,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Say hello in exactly one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-20250514\"}";
        var req = JsonUtil.fromJson(reqJson, ChatCompletionRequest.class);
        var apiKey = System.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY");
        if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty()) throw new IllegalStateException("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY must be set");
        try (var client = LiterLlm.createClient(apiKey, null, null, null, null)) {
        var result = client.chat(req);
        System.out.println(result.choices());
        System.out.println(result.usage());
        }
    }
}
```
